decision: Mochi-only is a narrower viable investigation, NOT READY for source adoption or release. Clover seam/layout failures are independent, but native Clover changes the geometry and paint environment.

candidate.scope: Only Mochi when formationC2 and hasDesignerIdleBody; all native paths, Soot, and Clover behavior unchanged.
candidate.sourceProposal: Add optional labelTarget vertical alignment top. Scene provides desired complete-label top; world-label-dom uses target.y directly for the target rectangle when aligned top, then converts result to existing node position. Keep current box.y behavior for every other label. Layout solver is unchanged; retain own-body avoidance.
candidate.forbidden: No (-28,+14) or other rejected Clover offset adopted; no shadow/paint threshold removal; no generic native-body obstacles or replacement solver.
